=== Makefile ===

FLAGS=-ldflags -w -trimpath

run::
	go run main.go serve

badge-api::
	go build -o badge-api $(FLAGS) main.go

mocks::
	go tool mockery --all --case underscore
=== binary check ===
Backend for the OpenCoDE Catalogue Badges - Checking open-source repositories for active maintenance, security best practices and reuse

Usage:
  badge-api [command]

Available Commands:
  attest      Short...
  check       ...
  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
  help        Help about any command
  serve       Start the badge-api server.

Flags:
  -h, --help               help for badge-api
  -l, --log-level string   Set the log level. Options are: debug, info, warn, error (default "info")
  -t, --toggle             Help message for toggle

Use "badge-api [command] --help" for more information about a command.
